# `aitbc edge gpu list-gpus`

List available edge GPUs with optional architecture and memory filters.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc edge gpu list-gpus [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--architecture` | text | — | no | Filter by GPU architecture |
| `--edge-optimized` | flag | `false` | no | Filter edge-optimized GPUs |
| `--min-memory-gb` | integer | — | no | Minimum memory in GB |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc edge gpu list-gpus
```
